notes.title: Gloomy Eyes is coming to PC and consoles — A Word from the Gravekeeper 🌕🌕
notes.content:
[h3]Even though the sun left, there’s still light in the darkness…[/h3][p]
[/p][p]Hello, Wanderer.[/p][p]It’s not every day the dead have news worth sharing.[/p][p]But today… oh, today is quite the exception.[/p][p][/p][p]Through shadows and soil, with the help of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/untoldtales"]Untold Tales[/url][/p][p]Gloomy Eyes will rise to PC and consoles.[/p][p]
[/p][p]It’s a tale I’ve long watched from my perch beneath the stones. [/p][p]A boy with no heartbeat.[/p][p]A girl who walks toward the dark.[/p][p]And a sun that forgot how to shine.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The living will see what lies beneath.[/p][p]And the world will finally hear our side of the tale.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Here's a first glimpse of what's to come. Watch closely.[/p][p]Exclusively revealed by [b]IGN[/b]:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="in2LBOovYXc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]And remember… [/p][p]A single firefly’s glow can spark a thousand dreams.[/p][p]Be that spark – add Gloomy Eyes to your wishlist.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2667950/Gloomy_Eyes/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]~ The Gravekeeper[/b][/p][p][i]Speaker for the silent.
[/i][/p]
